test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'GET' is coded as ‘50’ and 'CAB' is coded as ‘76’. How will 'RUN' be coded in the same language?
solution: The logic followed here is: **Logic: Sum of opposite letter position + 1 = Number.** 'GET' is coded as ‘50’ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cb88b3650ecd514342fff9a79582121ea94f79272964e8e63c08d4581a80ac6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d79f9300614ca6d2c717723c423a823d0036835941ecf4e4510471176e69ac83.png] And, 'CAB' is coded as ‘76’
